author: oNigel
body:
IGN:EdwinGamingYT_
When where you banned:? I was banned on may 28th  2015
Why were you banned: Flyhacking
Who banned you if known: Legoche
Why should we unban you:? I am a regular player of Minecraft and am 12 years old. I was banned 10 months ago and tried to appeal many times. My parents have taken more time to explain to me the rules of online gaming and I understand the unfairness of hackers. I am a much better player than I was. Any hacks I had are now deleted and I attach the screenshot to prove it. Please can you reconsider the ban and give me chance to play once more within the rules of the game/server. Many thanks.  

Heres the screenshots for proof http://imgur.com/a/M4pbw
